summary: Applied BIB-0027 (user ruling 2026-09-22: talking characters may be CGI animals for a realistic-fantasy film; brief.md corrected to 'Realistic fantasy film adapted from a fairy tale') to bible/creatures/creature.json and bible/creatures/index.json only. Kept CRE-001..004 (the real, silent, on-screen animals) and CRE-001's distinct_from link to CHAR-white-rabbit unchanged, per the rule that the waking-frame rabbit is unaffected. Updated only the fields BIB-0027 made stale, and registered new CGI rendering-spec entries for the two fantastical dream creatures that have no surviving human-performer alternative (Gryphon, Mock Turtle) plus one pending_H2 proposal for the pig-baby end-state.
